a.lede: The husband of alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed employee who was involved in an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, has even stronger ties to the Chinese intelligence services, U.S. intelligence officials have told Congress.
a.title: Husband of Jensen Huang’s mistress has much more significant Chinese intelligence connections than her, report claims

b.lede: The company’s board of directors has reinstated Huang a little more than a week after the CEO resigned amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report.
b.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
